description: 한국전자통신연구원_연구시설장비 현황 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전자통신연구원. 연구원에서 보유하고 있는 주요 연구시설 및 장비 현황자료입니다. 컬럼명: 순번, 한글장비명, 영문장비명, 모델명, 제작사, 취득일자, NTIS 등록번호. The portal shows 2023-04-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
